observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries high-arousal urgency in a negative valence — a forceful directive to erase knowledge, not a calm request.
Imperative 'Remove' with the absolutizing 'all' sustains the same urgent, negatively valenced erasure-demand as the prior directive.
Flat declarative correcting a record — low arousal, negative valence: a resigned, corrective settling after the urgent directives above.
